Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_world_entities, read-only analysis. __thiscall(this), RET (004d92aa), no argument, ECX game from BSP_Game_OnMove at 004e4feb, on the join point every frame path reaches, immediately before game+648h += 1. Sixteen identical blocks. Each fetches the input singleton with 004bec00 and applies the full 004c43c0 edge test to one 30h-byte record at inputSingleton+4h + id*30h: record+28h set, record+24h greater than zero, and either record+20h clear or record+1Ch not greater than zero. On a press it writes game+64Ch + 0.4 into the std::map<int,float> at 00e18a7c through operator[] at 004d6900, whose ECX is the literal 0E18A7Ch. The delay constant 00ce65d0 holds 3FD99999A0000000h, the double promotion of 0.4f, so the map stores an absolute deadline on the game+64Ch clock. Action ids in order: 4Ah 4Bh 4Eh 4Fh 50h 51h 52h 53h 54h 55h 46h 47h 4Ch 4Dh 57h 58h; 004d9251 confirms the divisor by computing input+4h+1080h for id 58h. docs/GAME_WORLD_ENTITIES.md.
